statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion events
The service is intended to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances during symptom onset
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and R42
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
